item.title: Preseterizer 0.3.0
item.description:
• In the Seeds panel, click a preset's row (or its tick) to tick it. While any are ticked, only those become seeds; Untick all goes back to all of them or the sample. Ticked seeds stay listed when you draw a new sample.
  • A long list's scroll bar now runs in its own lane at the right, so it no longer covers the ✕ buttons.
